# X.509 test fixtures, frozen. A private PKI generated once with
# OpenSSL 3.6.3 and checked in, so the suite needs no openssl and no
# network -- and so that the bytes under test never change under it.
#
# Every certificate is valid for twenty years from its generation, and
# every test that judges validity passes an explicit instant, so no case
# here starts failing on a calendar date.
#
#   root       self-signed CA, keyCertSign+cRLSign
#   inter      CA under root, pathlen:0
#   interfree  CA under root, no pathlen
#   subca      CA under interfree
#   subunder   CA under inter (whose pathlen:0 it violates)
#   leaf       serverAuth leaf under inter, rich SAN list
#   deep       serverAuth leaf under subca
#   violleaf   serverAuth leaf under subunder -- the pathlen violation
#   nosan      leaf with no subjectAltName at all
#   broad      leaf whose SANs are wildcards too broad to honour
#   critical   leaf carrying an unknown *critical* extension
#   noncrit    the same leaf with that extension non-critical
#   client     leaf whose only EKU is clientAuth
#   pss        the leaf re-signed with RSASSA-PSS
#   sha384     the leaf re-signed with SHA-384
#   sha1       the leaf re-signed with SHA-1, which must be refused
#   big        a 4096-bit leaf under inter
#   rogue      an unrelated self-signed CA
#   rogueleaf  a leaf for leaf.example.com signed by rogue
#
# A second, separate PKI for name constraints (RFC 5280 4.2.1.10), which needs
# certificates issued under a constrained CA and the first PKI's keys are not
# checked in. Its intermediate permits DNS:example.com, IP:10.0.0.0/255.0.0.0
# and email:example.com, and excludes DNS:bad.example.com.
#
#   ncroot      self-signed CA
#   ncinter     the constrained CA under ncroot
#   ncdirinter  a CA under ncroot constrained by dirName, a form this module
#               cannot compare, so nothing under it may be trusted
#   ncok        a leaf inside every permitted subtree
#   ncwrongdns  a leaf named www.other.com
#   ncexcluded  a leaf named bad.example.com, which is permitted and excluded
#   ncwrongip   a leaf at 192.168.1.1
#   ncsubmail   a leaf at me@mail.example.com, below the permitted host
#   ncsuffix    a leaf named notexample.com, which shares a suffix with the
#               permitted subtree and not a label boundary
#   ncdirleaf   a leaf under ncdirinter
#
# name <DER as hex>
root 
inter 
interfree 
subca 
subunder 
leaf 
deep 
violleaf 
nosan 
broad 
critical 
noncrit 
client 
pss 
sha384 
sha1 
big 
rogue 
rogueleaf 
ncroot 
ncinter 
ncdirinter 
ncok 
ncwrongdns 
ncexcluded 
ncwrongip 
ncsubmail 
ncdirleaf 
ncsuffix
